answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 76 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The atlas register is checked at draw time, willow lists the eligible set, and trellis seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 76 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
